title: 第335章 泰坦符文第334章 风暴巨人之力
slug: 异界冒险从组建冒险团开始
content_zh:
狂暴的雷电在沃尔体内肆虐，原本能够轻易烧毁肉体的能量此时却仿佛是一支被无形之手操控的符文笔，从肌肉纤维开始，逐渐刻画下无数神秘的纹路。
这些蕴含巨大能量的雷霆符文被刻画入沃尔的身体之中后，便快速改造着这具身躯，使其从内到外发生了翻天覆地的变化。
两个小时后，沃尔身上的异变这才缓缓结束，光芒消散，露出焦黑浴桶中皮肤光滑白皙的强壮身影。
“呼~”
沃尔长舒一口气，有力的气息将房屋内弥漫的水雾吹散，见沃尔真的没有被诅咒的迹象，莉亚这才松了口气，立刻用有些干涩的声音说道：
“团长，你别动，我先检查一下你的身体状况……”
原本想要活动身体，感受一番身体变化的沃尔，听到莉亚充满关心的声音，便站在原地不动，任由精灵法师上下其手，摸来摸去。
不过低头看着莉亚的头顶，沃尔这才发觉两人身高差和平时不太一样，看着眼前两只晃来晃去的尖耳朵，不由轻笑道：“莉亚，你怎么变矮了？”
莉亚白了沃尔一眼，没好气道：“你现在至少有两米高，当然显得我矮了。”
沃尔嘿嘿一笑，这才长了几厘米而已，要是自己选半巨人，甚至巨人的话，说不定一脚都能给这楼板踩塌了。
趁着莉亚检查身体的时间，沃尔将心神沉入神器战旗，查看自身的属性变化：
【沃尔·维托亚】
〖等级：8级14871600〗
〖属性：力量17→18，体质16→17，敏捷16，智力12，感知13，魅力17〗
〖技能：单手武器167，双手武器102，长杆武器170，盾防57，弓箭35，弩箭40，投掷145，潜行20，乘骑125，跑动103，侦查45，战术135，社交85，统御104，训练115，交易48，管理105，医术243，驯兽95〗
〖特质：符文血脉：你的身体中烙印着雷霆泰坦符文，闪电和雷鸣与你同在，血脉中还蕴含残破再生符文，让你的血液拥有再生之力。
灵能：源自灵魂的力量开始觉醒，你可以通过意念改变世界。
令沃尔有些意外的是，符文血脉竟然能提升一点力量和一点体质，18点力量啊，比之普通人强上十倍有余，普通大师阶战士也就这个水平！
除此之外，便是符文血脉，竟然将长寿和再生之血融入其中，长寿他倒不意外，毕竟风暴巨人的寿命也和精灵差不多，自己这点寿命不算什么，但再生之血，看样子，两者似乎是同源的？
想了一秒后，沃尔放弃了思考，直接问道：“莉亚，巨魔和巨人有关系吗？”

莉亚抚摸沃尔腹肌的手一顿，虽然不明白沃尔为什么突然问这个问题，但还是很快回答道：
“巨魔按照法师的种族分类，就是属于巨人大类的一员，相当于是巨人种族的旁支后裔，两者血脉源头出于一处。”
源头嘛，自然是伟大的巨人之父安南了，沃尔还想追问下去，莉亚已经预判了沃尔的想法，继续说道：
“里面牵扯了神祇的隐秘，我只知道这应该是巨人之父的家庭矛盾所致，至于具体原因，嗯，其实我也想知道，但书里没写。”
content_en:
Violent thunder and lightning raged in Wall's body. The energy that could easily burn the body now seemed like a rune pen controlled by an invisible hand. Starting from the muscle fibers, it gradually carved countless mysterious lines.
After these thunder runes containing huge energy were carved into Wall's body, they quickly transformed the body, causing it to undergo earth-shaking changes from the inside out.
Two hours later, the mutation on Wall's body slowly ended, and the light dissipated, revealing a strong figure with smooth and white skin in the blackened bathtub.
"Huh~"
Wall breathed a long sigh of relief, and the powerful breath blew away the mist that filled the house. Seeing that Wall really showed no signs of being cursed, Leah breathed a sigh of relief and immediately said in a dry voice:
"Captain, don't move. I'll check your physical condition first..."
Wall, who originally wanted to move his body and feel the changes in his body, heard Leah's caring voice, so he stood still and allowed the elf mage to touch him up and down.
But looking down at the top of Leah's head, Wall realized that the height difference between the two was different from usual. Looking at the two pointed ears dangling in front of him, he couldn't help but chuckled: "Leah, why have you become shorter?"
Leah rolled her eyes at Wall and said angrily: "You are at least two meters tall now. Of course you look shorter than me."
Wall chuckled. He had only grown a few centimeters. If he chose to be a half-giant or even a giant, he might be able to collapse the floor with just one foot.
While Leah was checking her body, Wall focused on the artifact war flag and checked his own attribute changes:
【Wal Vitoya】
〖Level: Level 8 14871600〗
[Attributes: Strength 17→18, Constitution 16→17, Agility 16, Intelligence 12, Perception 13, Charisma 17]
〖Skills: One-handed weapon 167, two-handed weapon 102, pole weapon 170, shield defense 57, bow 35, crossbow 40, throwing 145, stealth 20, riding 125, running 103, reconnaissance 45, tactics 135, social 85, control 104, training 115, trading 48, management 105, medicine 243, animal training 95〗
〖Trait: Rune Bloodline: Your body is imprinted with the Thunder Titan rune, lightning and thunder are with you, and your bloodline also contains broken regeneration runes, giving your blood the power of regeneration.
Psionics: The power from the soul begins to awaken, and you can change the world through your thoughts.
What surprised Wall was that the rune bloodline could actually increase a little strength and a little physique. At 18 points of strength, it was more than ten times stronger than ordinary people. Ordinary master-level warriors were only at this level!
In addition, the rune bloodline actually incorporates the blood of longevity and regeneration. He is not surprised by the longevity. After all, the lifespan of storm giants is similar to that of elves. His lifespan is nothing, but the blood of regeneration, it seems that the two are from the same source?
After thinking for a second, Wall gave up thinking and asked directly: "Lea, are trolls and giants related?"
Leah's hand caressing Wall's abdominal muscles paused. Although she didn't understand why Wall suddenly asked this question, she quickly answered:
"Trolls are classified according to the race of mages. They are members of the giant category. They are equivalent to side descendants of the giant race. The bloodline of the two originates from the same place."
The source, of course, is the great father of giants, Annan. Wall still wanted to ask further, but Leah had already predicted Wall's thoughts and continued:
"It involves the secrets of the gods. I only know that this should be caused by the family conflict of the father of the giant. As for the specific reason, well, actually I also want to know, but it is not written in the book."
